name: Diamonds
summary: A trick-taking game where crystals are gained via suit actions when voiding, winning tricks, and collecting suits.
rules_text: Shuffle 60 cards in 4 suits and deal 10 to each player. Dealer chooses 1-3 cards to pass left, each player passes same number. Player left of dealer leads each trick; others must follow suit if able. If unable to follow, player may play any card and immediately takes the action of the suit played: Diamonds takes 1 from supply to vault, Hearts takes 1 from supply to showroom, Spades moves 1 from own showroom to own vault, Clubs steals 1 from another's showroom to own. Highest card of led suit wins trick, stores cards face down, takes action of led suit, and leads next. After 10 tricks, most cards taken in each suit earns that suit action; ties give none. Players winning no tricks get two Diamond actions. Vault crystals are hidden and worth 2 points, showroom worth 1. Play 4-6 rounds by player count then highest score wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with hidden hands, crystal collection, suits - fits engine
